ruleDefinitions.name: Insecure Transfer Via Curl.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "curl.exe" with the "--insecure" flag.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\curl\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "curl\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX("\s-k\s") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-insecure.*")))
